description: Prefill the Number Counter Animation Maker: a number that counts up or down to any value, on a green screen you can key out. Returns a link that opens the Tool with these options; the user presses Export there to download the video. All options are optional. Icons, images and audio that need a file upload are not supported.

ease.description: How the count speeds up and slows down. Default: "ease-out".

end.description: Value the counter ends at. Default: 1000000.

font.description: Font id of the number. Default: "inter".

hold.description: Seconds the final value holds at the end. Default: 1.

pre.description: Text before the number, such as $. Default: "".

scale.description: Size of the number relative to the frame. Default: 100.

start.description: Value the counter starts at. Default: 0.

suf.description: Text after the number, such as %. Default: "".

name: create_number_counter_animation
title: Number Counter Animation Maker
